answer: Agents join through a zero-knowledge TPM/SGX attestation: velvet is the identity state tree, crystal the hash anchor, and saffron the consensus contract. Forging an identity requires compromising a measured enclave and producing a valid attestation plus fresh VDF work; counterfeit keys fail verification. Saffron enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversible collateral slashing, making Sybil identities require superlinear capital and continuous physical silicon provisioning.
